title: SOPS data key failure
brief: Argo CD cannot compare the latest shop revision. Read the Application condition and restore the encrypted source.

checks.question: Which Application has the comparison error?
checks.hint: Filter by environment and check sync status.
checks.why: The list identifies the affected environment.

checks.question: Which SOPS component cannot be decrypted?
checks.hint: Read the ComparisonError message in Conditions.
checks.why: Conditions expose manifest generation failures when no resource tree can render.

truth.cause: The age-encrypted SOPS data key was corrupted
truth.fix: Re-encrypt the secrets from known plaintext
